messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — I'm prepping a RICE recalibration for the quarterly roadmap. Main question: do we increase the implicit Impact weight for Dedicated/private deployment work? Customers keep surfacing isolation/SLA needs. Need decision by EOD Fri.

raj: +1. Renewals feedback shows that Dedicated fixes move the needle on churn more than new small features.

kyle: Curious — are we talking about changing the formula or just our interpretation of Impact when scoring Dedicated items?

emma: Not touching math. Proposal: when an item is "Dedicated / Private" tagged, treat Impact as 1.5x for scoring/ranking (not for billing). That nudges roadmap towards infra that preserves revenue.

sasha: Slight worry — this will bias us away from low-effort UX things that increase adoption. Can we instead split the prioritization pool (customer-critical vs growth) and allocate %?

maria: We should look at an example set. Quick calc below for two items so folks see effect.

pm-bot: ```
Item A: Dedicated-encryption (Dedicated tag)
Reach=2, Impact=8, Confidence=70%, Effort=5
RICE = (2*8*0.7)/5 = 2.24 -> with 1.5x impact => (2*12*0.7)/5 = 3.36

Item B: Authoring-ux (Growth tag)
Reach=5, Impact=4, Confidence=80%, Effort=3
RICE = (5*4*0.8)/3 = 5.33 -> unaffected by Dedicated boost
```

oliver: That makes sense numerically. But we should also add a sequencing rule: if Dedicated item unlocks multiple customers immediately, let it preempt a single high RICE but low revenue feature.

raj: Agreed. Suggest two guardrails: 1) Impact boost only applies when customer revenue at risk > $X/month OR > N enterprise seats; 2) small-effort growth wins can't be starved — reserve 25% of sprint capacity for incremental product work.

kyle: On confidence — some Dedicated asks are unproven (we haven't tested latency on their payloads). Should we lower Confidence instead of forcing Impact?

sasha: I prefer the revenue gating + capacity reservation approach. That balances retention and acquisition.

emma: Proposed launch criteria for Dedicated GA (short list):
- Performance SLOs met under customer workload (p90 latency < target)
- End-to-end auth/KMS integration validated
- Migration/runbook and rollback tested
- Legal & compliance signoff for data handling
If any fail, default to canary + extended trial.

maria: Also add: measurables for success for 90 days (customer uptime, token cost delta, acceptance tests).

pm-bot: Quick poll: react with :thumbsup: to adopt 1.5x Impact for Dedicated-tagged items with revenue gating + 25% capacity reservation for growth. React :thinking: if you want a different approach.

emma: I'll capture consensus in the RICE rubric doc and run a simulated re-score across the top 30 items tomorrow. If we get majority thumbs by EOD Fri, I'll update the pipeline generator.

raj: :thumbsup:

oliver: :thumbsup:

kyle: :thinking:

sasha: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup: 

emma: Thanks — will share the reranked list and call out items that flip because of this change.

kyle: One ask — when you publish rerank, include a short CSV we can import to our sprint planning board.

emma: Will do. Thanks everyone.
